workflow: Groups run in array order; tasks run in array order within their group unless dependsOn says otherwise.

Completed work is removed from this file - G00/G0C/G01/G02/G03 and the G04 auth core (headless settings, passwordless adapter, ninja auth class - each live-verified; commits d0b0304, aa2f03d, 19cf719) are done; git history holds the record. Group ARRAY ORDER is the execution order (outside-in per user decision 2026-07-11): shell first (docker, dev UX, CI), inner feature depth later.
One task = one working session. Set status=in_progress before starting; set done only when the endGoal is observed, not assumed.
Never start a task whose dependsOn are not all done.
After the last task of a group: run the group's checkpoint, fix any fallout, then `git commit -m "checkpoint(<groupId>): <group title>"`.
Tips are guidance, not prescriptions - decide from context; PLAN.md wins over any tip; record resolutions by appending to the task's tips.
Any task that adds an Env field updates config/env.py AND .env.example in the same task.
From G03 onward ruff+mypy must be green at every checkpoint; GitHub CI is expectedly broken until G10 rewrites it (no remote exists yet) - local checkpoints are the gate.

groups.title: Docker + compose rewrite
groups.rationale: Image and compose need the final dependency set and commands (db_worker, healthz); the G07 suite catches regressions; wave-3 cruft (old compose) dies here.
groups.checkpoint: docker compose up --build: web + worker + postgres:18 + mailpit all healthy; same auth/worker smokes pass against containers; image runs as non-root; commit.

groups.title: Dev UX: justfile + pre-commit
groups.rationale: Recipes reference compose.yaml/seed/worker/lint-imports, so it follows G07/G08; the pre-commit rewrite feeds the CI job next.
groups.checkpoint: Every just recipe runs; pre-commit run --all-files green including pre-push hooks; commit.

groups.title: CI/CD
groups.rationale: CI mirrors pre-commit and the compose smoke, so it must come after both exist; ends the broken-remote-CI window.
groups.checkpoint: Workflows lint clean (actionlint or careful review); after pushing to a GitHub remote: fast job + image job + secret scan green on a branch; commit.

groups.title: Tasks platform (background worker + scheduler)
groups.rationale: Proves the db_worker path that the welcome email already uses AND the scheduler story: recurring jobs run as EventBridge Scheduler cron -> ECS run-task management commands (sample_scheduled_job is the template), while async work flows through the django.tasks DB queue. Small group with its own checkpoint because it validates infrastructure, not code volume.
groups.checkpoint: Signup enqueues welcome email after commit; manage.py db_worker drains it to Mailpit; task result row visible in admin (or shell); sample_scheduled_job and the prune command run clean; commit.

groups.title: Admin: unfold + framework
groups.rationale: Needs the User model and auth to exist; lands before the test group so the admin-basics gate has a real admin to run against.
groups.checkpoint: Admin themed by unfold; users admin fully works (list/search/filter/edit/export) with explicit can_* permissions; generate_dashboard scaffolds a valid package; superuser bootstrap is repeatable; commit.

groups.title: Inner depth: users API + tests + gates
groups.rationale: The in-depth inside work (user decision: outside-in): mount+verify the /me exemplar endpoint, then the test suite and the cross-app gates that protect everything.
groups.checkpoint: uv run pytest green including both gates; coverage >= 80%; uv run lint-imports green; uv run mypy strict green repo-wide; commit.

groups.title: Docs
groups.rationale: Documenting last means documenting reality, not intent.
groups.checkpoint: A newcomer can bootstrap from README alone; ARCHITECTURE.md matches the implemented tree; every Env field appears in .env.example; commit.

groups.title: Final verification
groups.rationale: PLAN.md's 7 verification steps as the closing sweep.
groups.checkpoint: All three verify tasks done; final commit marks the transformation complete.

groups.title: Deferred items + user reviews (deliberately last)
groups.rationale: User decisions (2026-07-11): investigations, not-sure items, and social-login integration must NOT block the build - implementation proceeds on PLAN defaults; deferred/review work happens at the end. Review outcomes may change code: re-run affected group checkpoints and the G12 sweep afterwards.
groups.checkpoint: Every review task done with decisions recorded in tips; any resulting changes re-verified (affected checkpoints + G12 sweep); final commit.

tasks.title: Rewrite the production Dockerfile
tasks.endGoal: docker build succeeds from the pruned lock: uv builder image -> python:3.14-slim runtime, two-phase uv sync --locked --no-dev with BuildKit cache mounts + bind-mounted lock/pyproject, UV_COMPILE_BYTECODE=1 + UV_PYTHON_DOWNLOADS=0, compilemessages baked in (gettext in build stage), non-root user, CMD gunicorn honoring WEB_CONCURRENCY with --max-requests + jitter; NO collectstatic at build or boot.
tips: The image is the single ECS artifact - the worker service overrides the command (manage.py db_worker).
Release step (migrate + createcachetable + collectstatic) is a one-off ECS task, never the entrypoint.

VERIFIED: build clean; container uid=999(app) non-root; debug_toolbar ModuleNotFoundError (dev group absent); gunicorn boots on production settings with --env-file .env, healthz answers 301 (SSL redirect = app alive). 445MB.
compilemessages is conditional on .po existence (locale/ is still skeletons) - it activates automatically once translations land.
WEB_CONCURRENCY honored natively by gunicorn (no flag needed); worker service overrides CMD with manage.py db_worker.

depends_on with condition: service_healthy replaces wait-for-it scripts.

VERIFIED: up --build -> web/worker/postgres:18/mailpit all healthy; healthz+readyz 200 in-container; signup against container -> code email + welcome email drained by the WORKER via the DB queue (TASKS_IMMEDIATE=false); task row SUCCESSFUL in django_tasks_database_dbtaskresult; non-root uid 999.

DESIGN: containers run config.settings.production with ENVIRONMENT=local - deployment-only behaviors (SSL redirect, __Secure- cookies, S3, SES) gate on _DEPLOYED; verified both modes (compose smoke + deployed-mode assert script).
Release-step analog for fresh volumes: docker compose run --rm web python manage.py migrate && createcachetable (worker exits(1) until tables exist - by design, no boot-time migrate).
FIXED during smoke: /app itself was root-owned (COPY --chown covers contents only) -> mkdir /app/media + chown in runtime stage; readyz storage check green after.
